scientific_integrity: The general probability definitions and orbit-square identity of Ferrara–Trombetti–Tsang, the radical-brace construction, and prior classifications are acknowledged; all new assertions are proved by elementary valuations and probability counting.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for canonical brace solutions of one cyclic radical family, not arbitrary braces or all indecomposable solutions. Earlier cyclic brace classifications may implicitly cover the orbit partition. Finite independent computations do not prove infinite claims.
title: Cyclic radical braces: the exact joint flip–component law and a sharp valuation threshold
